CustomField.description: Written by RLM_DefaultPricingProcedure: the contract price it last copied into Sales Price. While Sales Price still equals this value, pricing treats it as system-set, so a changed or removed contract price replaces it on the next pricing run; a Sales Price typed by hand differs from it and is kept. Blank on lines that never received a contract price. Do not edit or show on layouts.
CustomField.label: Contract Applied Unit Price
